name: claude-token-status
description: Shows the remaining token budget for the current Claude Code session in the status bar.

commands.title: Claude Token Status: Open Session Transcript

claudeTokenStatus.warnThresholdPercent.description: Show a yellow warning when the remaining share of the token budget drops below this percentage.

claudeTokenStatus.criticalThresholdPerce.description: Show a red warning when the remaining share of the token budget drops below this percentage.

claudeTokenStatus.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) the status bar should refresh automatically.

claudeTokenStatus.claudePath.description: Path to the claude executable, if it isn't on PATH.
